title: Cosmic Prism Glass Eye
teaches: Build a luminous cosmic iris entirely from editable MotionLoom scene nodes.
Combine polar noise, deterministic particles, radial rays, glass refraction, dispersion, and advanced blend modes.
Keep optical effects clipped inside a feathered eye aperture while preserving independently adjustable groups.
Use separate low-frequency displacement and cellular pore noise for procedural skin, with filled tapered eyebrow hairs and layered eye-socket shading.
